scripts.dev:hx: cd apps/api-rs && cargo run --bin recitopia-hx -- open --api-url ${RECITOPIA_API_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8077}
scripts.dev:hx:local: cd apps/api-rs && cargo run --bin recitopia-hx -- open --api-url http://127.0.0.1:8077
scripts.dev:hx:materialize: cd apps/api-rs && cargo run --bin recitopia-hx -- materialize --api-url ${RECITOPIA_API_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8077}
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run build:api:rust
scripts.check: biome check . && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:web && bun run test:ml && bun run test:api
scripts.test:ml: PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/recitopia-pycache python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/ml -p '*_test.py' && PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/recitopia-pycache python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/ocr -p '*_test.py'
scripts.check:api:rust: cd apps/api-rs && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --all-targets --no-default-features --features system-duckdb -- -D warnings
